registryEvidence.locality: Omoku is listed by an official federal community-engagement page as the headquarters of Ogba–Egbema–Ndoni LGA in Rivers State; no Omoku-specific cadastral endpoint was found.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes a first-party state land/survey custodian and procedures, not anonymous parcel-data access, completeness, or citywide coverage.
